ValidationRule.description: Check that all franchise fields are not null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, OR(ISNULL(MTD_Total_Franchise__c), MTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(YTD_Total_Franchise__c), YTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Prior_Year_Franchise__c), Prior_Year_Franchise__c = 0),
OR(ISNULL(Cash_Bond_MTD_Total_Franchise__c), Cash_Bond_MTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Cash_Bond_YTD_Total_Franchise__c), Cash_Bond_YTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Prior_Year_Franchise_Cash_Bond__c), Prior_Year_Franchise_Cash_Bond__c = 0),
OR(ISNULL(FX_MTD_Total_Franchise__c), FX_MTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(FX_YTD_Total_Franchise__c), FX_YTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Prior_Year_Franchise_FX__c), Prior_Year_Franchise_FX__c = 0),
OR(ISNULL(CE_MTD_Total_Franchise__c), CE_MTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(CE_YTD_Total_Franchise__c), CE_YTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Prior_Year_Franchise_CE__c), Prior_Year_Franchise_CE__c = 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All franchise fields can not be null
